data.content_ref: inline:The adjudication-ritual flag (§11.3) is sustained because the critic harness enforces a verdict-shape that requires every surviving candidate to satisfy BOTH the frontier-claim-honest and frontier-above-floor criteria simultaneously. The covering principle is a *conjunctive gate*: a claim is only 'audited as honest' if it is epistemically non-deceptive (honest) AND exceeds the operational threshold (above-floor). SRC_007 and SRC_009 each record a single-criterion failure (0c61961a8085), which is fully consistent with the conjunctive gate—failing either disjunct triggers the §11.3 flag. The ritual flags sustained because the combined adjudication surface has not seen a claim that passes both at once.
